Industrious fortnight team minutes
The standing meeting was held at Aurelia Skyways for the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Attendees were Amara Johnson, Diego Larsen, and Louie. The team reviewed recent service notes and agreed that the ledger entries should stay clear, brief, and easy to trace so follow-up can happen without delay. <<FACT F100>> The group also talked through check-in handling, with a focus on keeping handoffs smooth, confirming documents early, and flagging any special needs before the desk becomes busy. <<FACT F092>> There was a short reminder to keep traveler updates consistent and to note any change in the pet's condition, carrier setup, or routing details as soon as they are shared. The team agreed that plain language helps reduce errors and makes the next step easier for everyone involved. A final note was made to keep questions routed through the desk channel so responses stay organized and nothing gets missed.
The meeting ended on a clear action note and was closed with thanks to everyone present.
